name: mind
description: Evidence-driven personal follow-up: private concerns and projects, exact source associations, bounded daily suggestions and restart-safe Agent reasoning.

tools.name: ui-sources
tools.description: Owner: read or replace up to four Files source paths (one per line). Reads at most 2000 characters per file; exact Files identity and read contract are bound at configuration. Empty text pauses source reads.
sideEffects: Writes bounded private application state; suggestions grant no permission.

tools.name: agenda
tools.description: Mind reasoning only: read private concerns and suggestions with cursor pagination. Responses fit 230 KiB encoded including the result wrapper; follow nextCursor until limited is false. Refresh after a cursor conflict.

tools.name: ui-agenda
tools.description: Owner: private agenda with cursor pagination. Responses fit 230 KiB encoded including result. Follow nextCursor while limited; refresh after records change.

tools.name: decisions
tools.description: Owner: reasoning decisions newest first, verified reports and notification receipts; limit 1–100. Follow nextCursor while limited to read all records. Encoded result wrapper is bounded to 230 KiB; refresh after records change.

tools.name: ui-dismiss
tools.description: Owner: dismiss exactly one pending suggestion by id with a stable request-key. No operation selector or caller identity arguments.
sideEffects: Writes bounded private application state; suggestions grant no permission.

tools.name: note
tools.description: Owner: create or edit a concern, stop it with done/dropped, or accept a proposal. request-key is required. Time fields are ISO or empty to clear; awaiting and links are strict JSON arrays. Links are evidence metadata, never permissions.
sideEffects: Writes bounded private application state; suggestions grant no permission.

tools.name: propose
tools.description: Authenticated modules suggest a bounded pending concern for owner review; no activation. request-key, title and reason required. signal-ids is a JSON array, max 20, limited to the source caller's own signals. This tool cannot dismiss suggestions.
sideEffects: Writes bounded private application state; suggestions grant no permission.

tools.name: signal
tools.description: Authenticated source modules push versioned observations. Real caller supplies source/moduleId; arguments cannot impersonate them. Exact event/ref/thread/from/domain matching with AND text conditions only requests verification. event-id dedupes within the caller.
sideEffects: Writes bounded private application state; suggestions grant no permission.

tools.name: report
tools.description: Current Mind reasoning only: submit one final structured report JSON with request-key and decision-id. Accepted candidates count only after this current Agent run's successful tool-result receipt and terminal success are verified. Owners cannot forge reports.
sideEffects: Writes bounded private application state; suggestions grant no permission.

tools.name: check
tools.description: Owner explicitly requests one bounded foreground review, or reconciles the outstanding reasoning run. Unknown work retains capacity; this does not create a parallel run.
sideEffects: May create or reconcile a durably keyed Agent reasoning run.

tools.name: ui-settings
tools.description: Owner read {} or save scalar Mind preferences. Background starts disabled. interval-minutes 5–120, daily-wakes 1–24, quiet times HH:mm, IANA timezone. notify-enabled is optional and defaults false.
sideEffects: Writes bounded private application state; suggestions grant no permission.

interval-minutes.description: Decimal integer string; local range is validated by Mind.

daily-wakes.description: Decimal integer string; local range is validated by Mind.

feedback-minimum.description: Decimal integer string; local range is validated by Mind.

feedback-half-life-days.description: Decimal integer string; local range is validated by Mind.

waiting-recheck-hours.description: Decimal integer string; local range is validated by Mind.
